business_summary: Shanghai Challenge Textile Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells high-end fabrics in China and internationally. The company offers performance, sport, and active-lifestyle materials and apparel; women's active wear comprising puffer jackets, bonded bras, and bonded leggings; men's active wear consisting of bonded run jackets, lined shorts, and active base tops; unisex outdoor wear, including protective jackets, lightweight hooded cagoules, and mid-layer pants; women's and men's outdoor wear, such as pullover puffers, base hooded tops, and base leggings; women's travel wear, which includes bonded rain jackets, layering tanks, and draped lounge pants; and men's travel wear, such as fleece bombers, lounge tees, and lounge pants. It also provides functional chemical fiber fabrics, wool products, and ready-made garments; clothing, apparel, accessories, and specialty textiles; textile and natural fibers, footwear, hats, and daily necessities; and medical protective equipment. In addition, the company engages in information transmission, computer services, and software activities. It exports its products. Shanghai Challenge Textile Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Shanghai, the People's Republic of China.
